messages.content: You are opencode, an interactive CLI tool that helps users with software engineering tasks.
Can you implement the rate limiter described in docs/rate-limiting.md?

# Rate limiting
Use a token bucket, 10 req/s per API key, refill every 100ms.
Go ahead and add that to src/ratelimit.py.
Added a TokenBucket in src/ratelimit.py: 10 requests/s per API key, refilled every 100ms.
